title: Balanced Through Breath
description: Join the Soulful Sister Collective for a special yoga & breathwork experience

Join the Soulful Sister Collective for a special yoga & breathwork experience

About this Event

Welcome to the Soulful Sister Collective! We're a community and sisterhood, dedicated to the inclusion, appreciation and empowerment of Black Women.
Join us on October 17th for a special 60-minute yoga and breathwork experience, where we lean into themes of completion, new beginnings, and possibility. Through intentional, breath-led movement and guided somatic breathwork, you’ll be invited to slow down, reconnect with your body, release what you’re ready to leave behind, and create space for what you’re choosing to step into next. Hang with us post class to connect with the collective 🩷
This is an opportunity to move, feel, breathe, and meet yourself exactly where you are while being witnessed and supported in community. Come as you are, take what you need, and give yourself permission to step more fully into your power, your truth, and yourself.
Meet Your Instructor: is a yoga teacher, somatic breathwork practitioner, dancer, and embodiment facilitator who creates spaces for people to reconnect with themselves through breath, movement, and awareness. Her work is rooted in accessibility, representation, community, and the belief that we all deserve spaces where we can soften, express ourselves fully, and show up just as we are. Through her offerings, Bree invites people to move beyond simply “doing” the practice and into feeling, exploring, and trusting what is already present within them.
